input.question: What is the population of Lawrence, Wisconsin?

documents.text: Lawrence, Rusk County, Wisconsin Lawrence is a town in Rusk County, Wisconsin, United States. The population was 240 at the 2000 census. According to the United States Census Bureau, the town has a total area of 47.7 square miles (123.6 km²), all land. As of the census of 2000, there were 240 people, 90 households, and 56 families residing in the town. The population density was 5.0 people per square mile (1.9/km²). There were 111 housing units at an average density of 2.3 per square mile (0.9/km²). The racial makeup of the town was 99.58% White and 0.42% Native American.
